subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept a metadata-only Computer Use provider manifest contract, and what host-permission trust semantics must that contract enforce?
rationale: This adds plugin manifest API surface used for pre-runtime discovery around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions, so automation should not decide the permanent trust boundary.

options.title: Accept metadata-only contract after security review
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR shape if it keeps runtime behavior plugin-owned and proves metadata cannot overstate permission authority.

options.title: Reject the manifest contract for now
options.body: Keep current Computer Use paths and require macOS host discovery to use existing plugin/runtime surfaces until maintainers settle the trust model.

options.title: Broaden into a runtime API design
options.body: Pause the narrow PR and design a larger Computer Use provider API if static manifest metadata is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Accept metadata-only contract after security review
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR shape if it keeps runtime behavior plugin-owned and proves metadata cannot overstate permission authority.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the maintainer-labeled issue and authored the linked implementation candidate.
